method_note: Analyzed the 48th AMS (Huntsville, 13-15 May 2026), the most recent completed edition, from the official programme. It has 9 technical sessions with 37 papers: 28 full papers and 9 poster papers, the posters presented in the 'Poster Session Preview' rapid-fire session. Each paper is mapped from its title as 1 unit split across at most 2 keywords, because several session titles (Release Mechanisms, Instruments, Actuators & Gimbals) are not topical in taxonomy terms. Special presentations (HLS overview, Artemis II/SLS), courses and tours were excluded. Tribology papers are split 0.5 mechanisms / 0.5 structures (materials). Papers whose main subject is deployment map fully to deployable-structures, and papers with deployment as one aspect get 0.5. Keywords below 0.02 (mechatronics, rovers, space-comm; together 0.04 of paper-units) were dropped and the remaining weights renormalized to sum to 1.
